new_assertions.body: The frozen q_RF, q_Sigma and q_SigmaRF candidates survive four fresh k3 geometry controls, including both 3-wide and 4-wide boards, without transition-congruence failure.
Across all fresh controls, applying both safe forgetting and transported column orbiting gives fewer Q-F classes than either operation alone.
Historical residual transposition automorphisms are stabilizer evidence, while q_Sigma is an orbit-quotient candidate; these are related but nonidentical symmetry constructions.

The identified-line hit-mask state rank-locally determines q_o, so it is an exact superrepresentation of q_o rather than evidence that q_o lacks line-identity information needed for ordinary future behavior.

add_fixed: q_Sigma equivariance survives four predeclared fresh k3 cases
q_SigmaRF is strictly smaller than q_o, q_RF and q_Sigma in all four fresh controls
